narrative:
Meridian 3-statement model — FY2025 actuals reconciled. Revenue USD 480.0B, EBITDA USD 208.7B (43.5%), operating income USD 183.7B (38.3%), net income USD 96.5B. Balance sheet balanced.

Income statement: cost of sales 50.2% of revenue; DD&A USD 25.0B on units-of-production depletion of producing assets.

Balance sheet: bonds, sukuk and borrowings of USD 162B against equity of USD 208B; DSO 35 days, DIO 25 days, DPO 40 days.

Cash flow: operating cash flow USD 108.5B, capex USD 49.9B, free cash flow USD 58.6B and dividends USD 81.6B.

signals.title: FY2025 close — GL reconciliation
signals.excerpt: All SAP GL accounts mapped to the planning COA. V_MAPPED_ACTUALS reconciles to the SAP trial balance within rounding.

signals.title: Dividend exceeds free cash flow
signals.excerpt: The FY2026 budget dividend of $83.7B exceeds free cash flow of $60.3B after $51.2B capex; the $23B gap is funded from cash and debt and widens to about $35B at $60 Brent.
